title: Not quite as sturdy as I was hoping
text: Not quite as sturdy as I was hoping. It's okay.  Not quite as sturdy as I was hoping.  If you're happy with a flimsy, very flexible whisk this is the one you want.  I do love that it was coated as I only had a metal whisk which was not good for my pans.
